title: Footage / Session Manifest (immutable, content-hashed)
description: Dataset-lane record of a collected footage session. This is NOT the ingestion VideoManifest contract owned by Member 1 (packages/contracts/video_manifest.py); it is the science-lane provenance and split-anchor record. It is immutable: `content_hash` is the SHA-256 over canonical JSON with the `content_hash` field omitted. Any edit changes the hash and is detectable. See data/ledger.md and RAZIEL_Master_Execution_Plan_v1.3.md §21.5/§26.1.

session_id.description: Stable session identifier. Splits are assigned by scenario/session, never by adjacent windows or file names.

scenario_id.description: Scenario grouping used as the split unit. All sessions of one scenario MUST land in the same train/dev/test split.

pool.description: Provenance pool. staged, organizer, and external pools are kept strictly separate (plan 21.5). 'external' is third-party footage used ONLY as a generalization probe: its video is external, its labels are always our own human ledger. Third-party annotations are never imported as ground truth.

camera_ids.description: Camera identifiers present in this session. Tracklet/actor identifiers are scoped to one camera/session and never imply biometric identity.

synthetic.description: True for deterministic synthetic fixtures used only for code tests. Real footage manifests set this false. No fabricated footage is ever labeled real.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the manifest was sealed.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) over canonical JSON of this object with `content_hash` omitted. Immutability check.

logical_path.description: Logical/relative reference. Raw footage is not stored in the repo; the manifest references it by id and hash.

source_sha256.description: Streamed SHA-256 of the source file. For synthetic fixtures this is the hash of the synthetic descriptor, and `synthetic` is true.

recording_start.description: Absolute recording start if known; time is read from PTS by ingestion, never inferred as frame_index/declared_fps.

status.description: Footage authorization status (§21.7). Missing coverage or authorization can never be laundered into a clean negative.

consent_recorded.description: Whether participant consent is recorded for staged footage.

staged_scenario_description.description: For staged pool: what was deliberately staged (repeated event, decoys, unobservable segment, etc.).
